lines.trans: Xingzi, a man brought several busloads of organised fans that day; who is he?
You mean Brother Fenhong, right? His name is Xu Tianze.
He is the president of Xin Huimei's official fan club.
He is a classic wealthy heir and carries strong influence in fan circles.
Right, the fans all followed his lead closely that day.
Fan culture today is very developed, and we need to respect fan opinions.
Maintaining good relations with fan clubs is vital for producing our shows.
Inside here is information on every celebrity fan club; borrow it and take a look.
A little pink notebook? Xingzi, is this from your personal stash?
